:::{#thm-wcgs-strat-from-contrast}

#### Converting between the corner-point and stratified parametrizations

Let $\beta_0$, $\beta_P$, $\beta_A$ and $\beta_{PA}$ be the coefficients of the corner-point parametrization (@eq-wcgs-model-1).
Let $\gamma_B$ and $\gamma_A$ be the stratum-specific intercepts,
and $\delta_B$ and $\delta_A$ the stratum-specific age slopes,
of the stratified parametrization of the same linear predictor (@eq-wcgs-model-strat).
Then:

$$
\ba
\gamma_B &= \beta_0
\\
\gamma_A &= \beta_0 + \beta_P
\\
\delta_B &= \beta_A
\\
\delta_A &= \beta_A + \beta_{PA}
\ea
$$

Equivalently:

$$
\ba
\beta_0 &= \gamma_B
\\
\beta_P &= \gamma_A - \gamma_B
\\
\beta_A &= \delta_B
\\
\beta_{PA} &= \delta_A - \delta_B
\ea
$$

:::

::: proof

This proof is the solution to @exr-strat-to-contrast.

:::
